svg.metadata:
# looply 商品业务全流程系统流程图（红布林对接版 — 三层架构） V9.1 # 研发编码参考数据，从 SVG <metadata> 提取
swimlanes: - key: "E" name: "红布林系统" - key: "A" name: "looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)" - key: "B" name: "looply 商品系统 (product/listing)" - key: "C" name: "looply 库存模块"
sections: - name: "① 同步留底" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：红布林推送" - type: process lane: "E" text: "红布林通过Webhook推送商品数据" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "商品数据(品类/品牌/系列/成色/折扣价/图片URL,中文)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "接收留底：存入红布林快照层(红布林商品ID为主键)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "完整保留中文原始数据(折扣价CNY/养护/改色/边油重做等)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "信息准备进度='待映射'" - type: start_end text: "同步留底完成(快照层,尚无product)" - type: note title: "三层架构-快照层" lines: - "快照层是全量主体：红布林推送100%落库，不丢不失败" - "红布林商品ID为主键，中文原始数据留底" - "此阶段尚无product，product在⑤上架时才创建" - "对比现有系统：Excel手动导入 → API自动同步" - name: "② 主数据映射" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：主数据映射" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载快照(信息准备进度='待映射')" - type: process lane: "A" text: "品牌/类目/系列/属性原始值 → looply英文标准库" - type: condition_branch lane: "A" text: "全部匹配成功?" yes_label: "全部匹配" no_label: "有失败" yes_branch: - text: "信息准备进度='待翻译'" no_branch: - text: "信息准备进度='映射异常'" - text: "系统定时自动重试(映射库更新后可自愈)" - text: "自动重试成功?" - type: start_end text: "映射完成(仍在快照层,无product)" - type: note title: "映射说明" lines: - "映射产物=looply英文标准值(品牌/类目/系列/属性)" - "映射结果供③翻译(命名规则)和④定价(TRR匹配)使用" - "映射异常系统自动重试，长期未解决才需人工" - "对比现有系统4.3：标准翻译表 → looply英文标准库" - name: "③ 商品翻译" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：系统自动翻译" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载快照(信息准备进度='待翻译',映射已完成)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "系统自动翻译：基于9张术语表(品牌/系列/颜色/材质/设计元素/附件/瑕疵/Category Suffix/尺码)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "取值规则：Design/Material/Color只取第一个,去空去重" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "按类目组装Product Name?" branches: - label: "Handbags" nodes: - type: process text: "有系列非Wallet:系列+尺码+设计+材质+颜色(无Suffix)" - type: process text: "Wallet有系列:系列+尺码+设计+材质+颜色+Suffix" - type: process text: "无系列:设计+材质+Suffix+尺码+颜色" - label: "Accessories" nodes: - type: process text: "有系列:系列+尺码+设计+材质+颜色+Suffix" - type: process text: "无系列:设计+材质+Suffix+尺码+颜色" - label: "Jewelry" nodes: - type: process text: "有系列:系列+设计+材质+颜色+Suffix+尺码" - type: process text: "无系列:设计+材质+颜色+Suffix+尺码" - type: condition_branch lane: "A" text: "翻译结果检查?" yes_label: "通过" no_label: "异常" yes_branch: - text: "翻译成功,结果存快照层" no_branch: - text: "中文残留/翻译失败→信息准备进度='翻译异常'" - text: "运营人工修正(编辑品牌译文/Product Name)" - type: condition_branch lane: "A" text: "映射✅ + 翻译✅?" yes_label: "均完成" no_label: "未齐" yes_branch: - text: "信息准备进度='信息就绪'(等待选品定价)" no_branch: - text: "继续等待未完成项" - type: start_end text: "翻译完成" - type: note title: "翻译说明" lines: - "系统自动翻译，人工仅处理异常(中文残留/翻译失败)" - "Wallet范围:Wallet/Passport Holder/Cosmetic Pouch/Card Holder/Coin Purse/Key Pouch" - "Wristlet不属于Wallet，按Jewelry命名规则处理" - "翻译结果存快照层，供⑤上架时写入product" - "对比现有系统4.2：Excel离线翻译 → 系统在线自动翻译" - name: "④ 选品定价" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：选品定价" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载快照(信息准备进度='信息就绪',映射+翻译均完成)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "读红布林折扣价(快照): A=折扣价/6.86(CNY→USD)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "读TRR参考价: C=TRR均价(按brand+series+size+condition匹配)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "通过排除检查?" on_no: "排除(养护/改色/边油重做/折扣价无效)→'已排除'" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "类目+系列分流?" branches: - label: "包袋Top系列(有C)" nodes: - type: process text: "公式3:B146≤70%C → 公式1:B146≤80%C" - type: process text: "公式2:B128≤90%C → 公式4:B128≤C" - type: process text: "公式5:B122≤1.10C → 公式7:兜底B122" - label: "包袋非Top/无C/宝格丽" nodes: - type: process text: "公式6: B=ceil(1.28A+181)" - label: "非包袋(非排除大类)" nodes: - type: process text: "固定公式: B=ceil(1.46A+207)" - label: "未命中" nodes: - type: process text: "不选中" - type: process lane: "A" text: "低价修正: B≤500→ceil(1.46A+207); Speedy例外不选中" - type: process lane: "A" text: "Cost Price: 折扣价≤B保留原文, 折扣价>B→折扣价/6.86" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成选品预览(挂牌价B/公式编号/CostPrice/选中原因/排除原因)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营确认执行?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "选中→信息准备进度='已定价', 挂牌价+CostPrice+公式存快照层" - type: process lane: "A" text: "排除/不选→信息准备进度='已排除'(记录原因,快照层留底)" - type: start_end text: "选品定价完成" - type: note title: "定价说明" lines: - "核心：定价在product之前，操作快照层数据" - "定价结果(list_price_usd/cost_price_usd/公式/状态)暂存快照层" - "product+库存+listing在⑤上架时一次性创建，定价不创建任何实体" - "公式: B146=ceil(1.46A+207), B128=ceil(1.28A+181), B122=ceil(1.22A+172)" - "Top+C判断顺序:3→1→2→4→5→7；无C/非Top/宝格丽→6；非包袋→B146" - "排除大类:包袋/服饰/鞋靴/腕表(固定公式排除,非包袋公式排除)" - "TRR每次即时读取当前数据，不持久化副本" - "对比现有系统4.1：Excel离线定价 → 快照层在线定价" - name: "⑤ 上架发布 ★" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：上架发布" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载快照(信息准备进度='已定价')" - type: process lane: "A" text: "上架就绪校验(ProductName/成色/描述/图片URL/挂牌价)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "中文残留检查通过?" on_no: "阻断:标记人工处理(覆盖title/description/metafields)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成Handle: slugify(Brand+' '+ProductName)+'-'+ItemID" - type: condition_branch lane: "A" text: "SKU/Handle冲突?" yes_label: "冲突" no_label: "无冲突" yes_branch: - text: "skip:SKU或Handle已存在→跳过" no_branch: - text: "ready:可上架" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营确认上架?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "① 匹配/创建标品SKU" - type: condition_branch lane: "B" text: "SKU已存在?" yes_label: "已存在" no_label: "不存在" yes_branch: - text: "复用已有SKU" no_branch: - text: "创建标品SKU(brand+series+category+属性)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "② 创建product(完整英文数据,一次成型)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "title/vendor/body_html/tags/template/taxonomy/metafields" - type: process lane: "B" text: "关联sku_id(BIGINT NOT NULL)+红布林商品ID(external_item_id)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "source='plum', product_status='待核验'" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "③ 创建库存主体(一物一码)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "创建inventory_item(product_id, qty=1)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "写入库存流水(INBOUND +1)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "④ 创建listing(渠道商品)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "创建listing(渠道+市场+挂牌价+CostPrice)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "下载图片并关联(商品/成色图在前+瑕疵图在后,保持源顺序)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "⑤ 审计验证(product/SKU/taxonomy/metafields/图片/库存/listing)" - type: condition_branch lane: "A" text: "审计通过?" yes_label: "通过" no_label: "有差异" yes_branch: - text: "可发布" no_branch: - text: "按可修复项补写→重新审计" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "⑥ 激活发布" - type: process lane: "B" text: "product_status→'销售中', listing=Active" - type: process lane: "A" text: "回写快照: 信息准备进度='已上架'+product_id" - type: start_end text: "上架发布完成" - type: note title: "上架说明-核心★" lines: - "核心：product+SKU+库存+listing一次性创建(对齐现有业务3.1)" - "现有系统3.1调Shopify API创建Product(variant+库存=1)" - "looply映射：Shopify Product → product + listing + inventory_item" - "创建链路6步：SKU→product→inventory→listing→审计→激活" - "product_status由商品系统定义，红布林对接作为业务场景接入" - "Handle=slugify(Brand+ProductName)+'-'+ItemID" - "Template按类目:bag/wallet/accessory-other/jewelry/watch" - "Metafields按类目区分(bag/wallet/accessory/jewelry各有专属字段集)" - "图片按源顺序下载，提交前恢复index顺序" - "中文检查覆盖title/description/metafields，检出即阻断" - "审计可修复项自动补写(core/variant/taxonomy/metafields/图片/listing)" - "3.2修复场景：创建时审计防错，已上架商品修正走⑧信息变更" - name: "⑥ 红布林状态同步" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：红布林状态推送" - type: process lane: "E" text: "红布林推送:商品下架信号(红布林商品ID+状态)" - type: process lane: "E" text: "注:红布林侧「售出」与「下架」是同一下架信号" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "状态推送" - type: process lane: "A" text: "覆盖快照(该红布林商品ID最新状态)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "按红布林商品ID查询product" - type: condition_branch lane: "B" text: "product存在且有listing?" yes_label: "有" no_label: "无/未建" yes_branch: - text: "返回product(status/sku_id/关联listing)" no_branch: - text: "未建product或无listing→仅覆盖快照,结束" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "looply内部判断场景?" branches: - label: "售出" nodes: - type: decision text: "订单保护检查通过?" on_no: "有活跃订单,转异常处理" - type: process text: "库存清零 inventory_item(qty=0)+流水(SOLD -1)" - type: process text: "下架listing, product_status='已售出'" - label: "普通下架" nodes: - type: process text: "库存置0不可售 inventory_item(qty=0)" - type: process text: "下架listing(不删除), product_status='已失效'" - label: "重新上架" nodes: - type: process text: "恢复listing(Active)+库存恢复可售" - type: process text: "product_status='销售中'" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "回查验证通过?" on_no: "标记异常,人工介入" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: start_end text: "状态同步处理完成" - type: note title: "状态同步说明-核心★" lines: - "红布林侧「售出」与「下架」是同一下架推送信号,不区分" - "looply 收到后内部判断具体场景:售出/普通下架/重新上架" - "售出与普通下架都清零库存(一物一码qty=1,无'保留数量'概念)" - "两者区别仅在 product_status:售出='已售出',普通下架='已失效'" - "订单保护:售出场景有活跃订单不直接清零,转异常处理" - "未建product的商品(仅快照层):仅覆盖快照最新状态" - "listing 下架但不删除,便于重新上架时恢复" - "对比现有系统3.5清理:手动Excel对账 → API自动同步+定期对账安全网" - name: "⑦ 商品信息变更" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品信息变更" - type: process lane: "E" text: "红布林通知:信息变更(红布林商品ID+变更字段+新值)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "信息变更通知" - type: process lane: "A" text: "覆盖快照(写入新的中文原始值)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "按红布林商品ID查询product" - type: condition_branch lane: "B" text: "product存在?" yes_label: "已建" no_label: "未建" yes_branch: - text: "返回product当前数据" no_branch: - text: "未建product→仅覆盖快照,后续加工使用最新值" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "变更类型?" branches: - label: "折扣价变更" nodes: - type: process text: "已上架→重新定价(A=新折扣价/6.86,B=f(A))" - type: process text: "更新listing挂牌价+CostPrice(人工确认)" - label: "图片变更" nodes: - type: process text: "下载新图→更新listing图片(保持源顺序,自动)" - label: "品类/品牌/系列" nodes: - type: process text: "重新映射+重新翻译→更新product英文数据(人工确认)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "回查验证通过?" on_no: "标记异常" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: start_end text: "信息变更处理完成" - type: note title: "信息变更说明" lines: - "先覆盖快照(中文原始值)，再按是否已建product决定联动" - "未建product：仅覆盖快照，后续加工时用最新值" - "价格变更人工确认；图片自动；类目/品牌人工确认" - "也覆盖内部数据修正场景(对应现有系统3.2修复商品)" - "映射表更新后已建product的修正：运营发起重新映射+翻译" - name: "⑧ 营销选品" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：营销选品" - type: process lane: "A" text: "运营设置筛选(类目/品牌/系列/颜色/成色/价格区间/文本搜索)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "查询product_status='销售中'+有listing+有库存" - type: process lane: "B" text: "返回筛选结果(listing级)" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "展示筛选结果" - type: process lane: "A" text: "勾选商品→加入选品篮(按variant维度,跨轮次保持)" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "选择操作?" branches: - label: "导出Excel" nodes: - type: process text: "生成Excel+写入导出历史" - label: "批量打标签" nodes: - type: process text: "批量写Tag(product级)+回查确认" - type: start_end text: "营销选品完成" - type: note title: "营销选品规则" lines: - "操作实体=listing(渠道商品)，非product" - "选品篮按variant维度，支持保存/清空/导出/打标签" - "Tag实际写在product级别，导出按listing级别" - "对比现有系统3.3：功能一致，数据源从Shopify缓存改为looply商品系统" - name: "⑨ 商品改价" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品改价" - type: process lane: "A" text: "筛选product_status='销售中'→加载listing当前价格" - type: process lane: "A" text: "运营设定目标售价B(+可选Cost Price)" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "价格变动方向?" branches: - label: "涨价(B>price)" nodes: - type: process text: "price=B; 原compare-at>B时保留,否则清空" - label: "降价(B<price)" nodes: - type: process text: "price=B; compare-at=max(原price,原compare-at)" - type: decision text: "差值≥30?" on_no: "不执行(差值不足)" - label: "B=compare-at" nodes: - type: process text: "price=B, 清空compare-at" - label: "B=price" nodes: - type: process text: "价格不变; Cost有变化时仍可执行" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营确认执行?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "执行价格更新(price+compare-at)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "更新listing价格" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "更新Cost Price→inventory unitCost" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "回读验证通过?" on_no: "标记失败,记录原因" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: start_end text: "商品改价完成" - type: note title: "改价规则" lines: - "改的是listing价格(挂牌价/compare-at)，不改product" - "降价差值不足30不执行，避免频繁微调" - "B=price时Cost变化仍可处理(只更新unitCost)" - "写入后回读验证，确保一致后才标记完成" - "对比现有系统3.4：规则一致，接口从Shopify改为looply商品系统"
svg.text: looply 商品业务全流程系统流程图（红布林对接版 — 三层架构）
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
looply 商品业务层 (快照层/加工)
红布林通过Webhook推送商品数据
商品数据(品类/品牌/系列/成色/折扣价/图片URL,中文)
接收留底：存入红布林快照层(红布林商品ID为主键)
完整保留中文原始数据(折扣价CNY/养护/改色/边油重做等)
同步留底完成(快照层,尚无product)
加载快照(信息准备进度='待映射')
品牌/类目/系列/属性原始值 → looply英文标准库
信息准备进度='映射异常'
系统定时自动重试(映射库更新后可自愈)
映射完成(仍在快照层,无product)
加载快照(信息准备进度='待翻译',映射已完成)
